title: Events alert — 2026-11-09
body:
Two chain events tomorrow.

• Tue 14:30 Berlin / 08:30 ET — October CPI. Consensus: headline +0.2–0.3% MoM (~3.7% YoY), core +0.2% MoM (~2.5% YoY); BLS won't publish most 12-month changes (Oct 2025 uncollected), so MoM is the comparable measure. Hot core keeps the December hike (~75–85% priced) locked — discount-rate compression hits semis and neoclouds first; a cool print is the relief valve.

• Tue 23:00 Berlin / 17:00 ET — CoreWeave Q3: ~$3.5–3.6B revenue (+~159%), loss ~$1.2/share, $104.2B backlog (June 30). Options imply ±21%; stock −49% in a month near its 52-week low — funding cost and backlog conversion are the test, not demand. Read-across: NBIS/IREN, power order books.

• Tue 06:30 Berlin: TSMC October monthly revenue.

Sleeves: semis and infrastructure carry the risk; power holds; 15% cash stays parked until CPI.

Sources: web search 2026-11-09 (finwire/TradingView, TipRanks, Barchart, TSMC IR).
